name: Van David Niccolo Fontanilla
headline: I keep hospital networks running, turn data into decisions, and bring a designer's eye to everything I build.
summary: IT professional with nearly 10 years of experience in network administration, healthcare information systems, and software quality assurance. I'm skilled in Microsoft SQL, LAN/WAN management, system security, and data-driven reporting, and I'm known for dependable technical support and turning data into practical insights for management. I also bring a creative edge from my background in graphic design and multimedia.
